rationale.conceptual: The method is an established transfer-matrix extension to piezoelectric layers, with explicit formulas provided. It still requires careful translation of many algebraic terms into code, handling of complex arguments, eigenvalue extraction, and root-finding for band edges and surface-wave determinants. This is more than a textbook operation and needs genuine understanding, but not novel research-level derivation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of three sequential, independent computations (bulk bands, surface velocities, effective constants), each outputting a simple CSV or JSON. The reference solution uses only Python and NumPy, no external tooling, data fetching, or fragile orchestration. It is straightforward I/O with minimal dependencies.

The math is non-trivial but fully specified, and the task produces three artifacts with straightforward I/O using only standard Python libraries. Resource needs are tiny: only material constants and a few lines of code; no GPU, negligible data, and minimal memory.
